episode_summary: In this episode, Sean Shackleton shares her journey of leveraging YouTube for real estate lead generation, emphasizing the importance of consistency and patience. Despite initial challenges, her commitment to producing quality content led to significant business growth, demonstrating the potential of YouTube as a powerful tool for real estate agents.
